title: This Lake Turned Pink in Days… and It Sits in a Crater From Space
caption: In June 2020, Lonar Lake in Maharashtra turned from green to pink in a few days. The bowl it sits in was punched into solid lava rock by a rock from space, and scientists still argue about when. #lonar #lonarlake #crater #india #history #mystery #science #shorts
